config._covariance_history_prices_note: daily closes per symbol the PortfolioManager keeps for the optimiser covariance, one per date, oldest dropped first; absent means 756 (the trend sleeve own cap); at least 2
config._covariance_stale_dates_note: how many dates of the union of the covariance symbols' dates a symbol's last close may trail the newest before the optimiser leaves it out of the date intersection (its column becomes the guarded 0.01 variance, WARN COVARIANCE_STALE_PARTICIPANT); at exactly this many it stays; absent means 5; a whole number of at least 0, e.g. 3 to leave out a symbol more than three dates stale
config._description: QT_CONSERVATIVE_PORTFOLIO: the QT desk book (desk editing on). A copy of CONSERVATIVE_PORTFOLIO.
config._equity_slow_rule_note: required; on the book's first sleeve a negative combined forecast of these symbols stands only when the scaled forecast of every pair named is negative, and is 0 otherwise
config._qt_note: QT platform (docs/design/qt-contract.md): desk_editable turns on the three books (system, qt_proposal, qt) and the desk commands; false runs and stores the system book only
config._sizing_note: required; half_compounding: the book is sized on starting_capital less the drawdown of its cumulative settled net P&L from its running peak, never above starting_capital; starting_capital must equal initial_capital

live._note: Must match backtest.lookback_years (2 yrs ≈ 730 days). Strategy needs 256+ trading days for longest EMA and 252 for vol_lookback_long.
live._note_spinoff_child_policy: E2-F31. What to do with a company a spinoff hands you. liquidate_at_first_close (default) books the child and sells it at its first close. hold keeps it, and is only safe when the child is itself in the configured universe -- otherwise no bars are loaded for it and every later run reports 'Missing T-1 price for symbol with a non-zero position' and rolls the target back forever (F-4). Unrecognised text takes the default.

optimization._one_pass_note: required on a futures book: cost_penalty_scalar is the cost multiplier of the one optimisation pass, sign_close_band the forecast below which a sign close waits, b_sigma_floor the floor of the no-trade buffer as a ratio to the risk target; the retired keys tau, asymmetric_risk_buffer and buffer_size_factor are refused there

modules._missing_symbol_policy_reason: Schema-1 behaviour, migrated literally: risk_manager.cpp:55-58 gates the book on the subset of its symbols present in the window (T-4 §10). Changing it is its own measured commit.
modules._overlay_limits_note: the overlay reads the book in capital terms (weights on the sizing capital): R_max, R_jump_max and R_shock_max are ratios to the first sleeve's risk target tau; max_gross_leverage and max_net_leverage are the gross and net leverage limits; per_name_cap is the cap on one symbol's weight; trim_max is the most contracts the trim removes in a day. All required on a futures book; var_limit, jump_risk_limit and max_correlation are retired here and in risk_reporting, and max_leverage at the top level, and each is refused

risk_reporting._note: RA-01: the live runners' snapshot RiskManager reads this block through AppConfig::risk_config; on day one it mirrors the gate (HD Q5).

config._idm_rationale: Carver Table 16 (Advanced Futures Trading Strategies, p.125): 30+ instruments -> 2.50; the universe is 36 names. The formula 1/sqrt(w'Hw), H the correlation of the instruments' subsystem returns floored at 0, reaches the 2.5 cap on the 36 names. HD 2026-09-25
